title: De-amplifying Bias from Differential Privacy in Language Model Fine-tuning

bias_targets.methodology: Prompting models with gendered and gender-neutral templates (using HONEST, Regard, and BOLD datasets) and measuring differences in toxicity, sentiment, occupation word co-occurrences, generated gender term counts, and statistical distances (KL divergence and Hellinger distance) between sequence probability distributions.
